company.name: Aivar Innovations
company.shortDescription: Aivar Innovations is an AI-focused technology services company specializing in end-to-end AI solutions for startups and enterprises.
company.description:
Aivar Innovations is an AI technology consultancy. The company delivers end-to-end AI solutions, including strategy consulting, custom ML models, generative AI applications, managed AI/ML operations, data analytics, and AWS-based cloud modernization. Aivar accelerates business transformation with AI-augmented teams that build enterprise-grade platforms, conversational intelligence, and scalable solutions. Named after the Tamil word for "five people" (with the customer as the fifth), it emphasizes high-impact use cases across industries.
